loading.title: EESTLAND Anno Domini 1343
context_intro: Caravans vanish along the old roads.
Merchants whisper of something in the dark.

npc_intro.player_text: You look like a man who knows this place.
npc_intro.text: I know the Baltic roads. Even the ones best left alone.

npc_identity.text: A navigator. I know the Baltic coasts, the old roads, and the places sensible merchants avoid. I might be looking for work, if the work is worth my time.

responses.text: You must have a lot of personality to come out dressed like this in the street.
Are you a comedian by any chance, Navigator?
I will leave you to it.

npc_silent_stare.player_text: You must have a lot of personality to come out dressed like this in the street.

responses.text: Then I shall leave you to your honor.

npc_final_insult.text: You insulted me for the last time.

npc_hendrik_identity.player_text: Are you a comedian by any chance, Navigator?
npc_hendrik_identity.text: No, I am not. And the name is Hendrik.

responses.text: I will leave you to it.

npc_ask_name.text: Interesting that you ask. Before we discuss business, what is your name?

npc_ink_request.text: Good, Rebane. I have run out of ink, and without ink my maps are useless. Bring me some, and perhaps I will decide you are worth my time.

responses.text: I will find ink for you.

npc_after_identity.text: Back again? If you want a navigator's time, show me that you can notice what is needed.

npc_waiting_for_ink.text: Bring me ink for my maps, Rebane. Then we can discuss opportunities.
